info.title: neolinter
info.description: Neolinter command line: on-demand solution-wide analyses (dead code, duplicated code) with SARIF output.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Neolinter command line: solution-wide analyses that are too expensive to run while typing.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Run a solution-wide analysis on demand and report the results as SARIF 2.1.0.

commands.name: dead-code
commands.description: Report types and members that nothing in the solution references.

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file. Defaults to neolinter.json next to the solution.

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write the report to. Defaults to the standard output.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Lowest finding level that makes the exit code 1; findings below it are still reported. [default: warning]

options.name: --baseline
options.description: SARIF log of a previous run: findings it already contains are neither reported nor counted.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Solution (.sln, .slnx) or project (.csproj) to analyse. Defaults to the single solution of the current directory.

commands.name: duplicates
commands.description: Report sequences of statements repeated across the solution.

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file. Defaults to neolinter.json next to the solution.

options.name: --output

options.name: --fail-on
